name: kempo-files
description: File library extension for kempo — upload, organize and serve arbitrary files through a permission-gated API
author: Dustin Poissant

name: kempo-game
description: A generic multiplayer game layer for kempo: saved games with invited players, live state sync over kempo's realtime WebSockets, timed and on-demand saves, a backend SDK, hooks and a frontend SDK
author: Dustin Poissant

name: kempo-inventory
description: A basic inventory management system for kempo cms
author: Dustin Poissant

name: kempo-media
description: Media library extension for kempo — upload and manage images, video, audio, 3D models, and archives, stored in kempo-files with thumbnails from kempo-thumbs
author: Dustin Poissant

name: kempo-oauth
description: Sign in with Google, GitHub, Facebook, X and Microsoft for kempo — OAuth 2.0 login and registration buttons, with the keys managed in the admin portal
author: Dustin Poissant

name: kempo-payments
description: Payment processing for kempo — provider-agnostic payment intents, capture and refunds, with Stripe built in
author: Dustin Poissant

name: kempo-products
description: A product catalog for kempo cms: browse, filter and inquire about products, with no checkout required
author: Dustin Poissant

name: kempo-products-inventory
description: Connects kempo-products to kempo-inventory: selling a product uses up the raw materials it is made from
author: Dustin Poissant

name: kempo-tax
description: Sales tax, VAT and GST for kempo — look up what to charge for an address and items, with Stripe Tax built in
author: Dustin Poissant

name: kempo-thumbs
description: Automatic thumbnail generation for kempo-files — ffmpeg-backed, for images, video and audio
author: Dustin Poissant

name: kempo-user-dirs
description: Private per-user file space for kempo — a personal folder each member can upload to, with plan-based storage quotas
author: Dustin Poissant
